title: Notifications: blocked escalation + wave-complete sounds
description: Plugin event hook on pane.agent_status_changed: a herd worker entering blocked triggers notification.show with --sound request naming the tick; wave completion (all wave workers settled per manifests+tk state) triggers --sound done. Debounce so one transition = one notification. Implement as a tk herd notify hook command (cobra/legacy/ResetFlags/ExitError) invoked by the plugin events section; unit tests on the decision logic against herdtest; live verify both sounds once.
acceptance_criteria: Live: blocked worker raises request-sound notification naming the tick; wave completion raises done-sound; no duplicate notifications for one transition
